summary: Iteration 8 (Admin/Owner Command Center) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (test_iteration8.py) covers owner/admin/perm authorization matrix, overview, all 5 analytics endpoints, growth (7/30/90), live activity pagination, top-performers, funnel, market, talent, monetization, search, audit logs, settings GET/PUT (10 then restored to 7), export CSV (companies text/csv verified + subscriptions), staff CRUD (create/login/perm-403/deactivate), audit log creation via add category, and regression logins. Result: 33/33 assertions pass (first run all pass; re-run shows 28 pass + 5 skipped because Admin Uji already deactivated — expected). Frontend UI tested via Playwright: owner login redirects to /admin, Command Center shows Business Health banner (+100% deltas), Alert Center (2 lowongan / 5 perusahaan / 2 payment pending, clickable), 9 KPI cards (Pelamar 8, Perusahaan 12, Lowongan Aktif 20, Total Lamaran 4, User Aktif 1, Perusahaan Aktif 8, Career Pro 3, Company Member 1, Revenue Rp 244.000), Quick Actions row, mini area chart 7 hari (recharts), global search returns Budi Santoso + related lamaran. Analytics page all 5 tabs (Pertumbuhan/Funnel Lamaran/Pasar Kerja/Talent & Matching/Revenue & Konversi) render; range switch (7/30/90/6bln/1thn) works; area charts render for pelamar/perusahaan/lowongan/lamaran baru. Live Activity feed shows interview/etc entries. Audit Log table renders with headers. Tim Admin page lists staff with Tambah Admin. Settings shows Business Rules. Career Pro page shows KPI (3 Aktif). Candidates page shows Career Pro / Free filters. AdminJobs has Views + Lamaran columns. Regular admin login: sidebar correctly HIDES Tim Admin & Settings (ownerOnly filter works); accessing /admin/staff shows 'Anda tidak mengelola tim admin' guard. Company & candidate dashboards regression pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3434 lines — consider splitting admin/analytics/monetization into routers/modules for maintainability (guideline >700 lines).

seed_owner (line 2719) does not update role if existing user's role != owner; only updates password. If owner email was pre-seeded as a candidate/admin, role could stay wrong. Currently fine because seed adds role='owner' when password mismatch, but edge case: if password matches but role is 'admin', it stays admin. Consider always ensuring role='owner' and permissions=['all'].

require_perm allows fallback to ['all'] when permissions is missing on a user doc (line 2705). This is fine for legacy admins but means new admins without permissions accidentally get full access. Recommend explicit empty list default in staff-created accounts.
